title: Communication on European Tech Sovereignty, and an EU Open-Source Strategy
summary: The European Commission published a communication addressing European technological sovereignty, accompanied by a comprehensive EU open-source strategy. This policy framework aims to reduce dependency on non-EU technology providers and promote open-source adoption across member states for strategic digital infrastructure.
problem_solved: Addresses Europe's strategic dependency on foreign technology providers and establishes a framework for digital autonomy.
why_valuable: Provides a concrete policy roadmap for EU member states to adopt open-source solutions and strengthen technological sovereignty.
